:::{#def-mutual-information}
#### Mutual information

The **mutual information** between discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$
is the reduction in the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy)
of $Y$ from learning $X$:

$$I(X; Y) \eqdef H(Y) - H(Y \mid X),$$

where $H(Y \mid X)$ is the [conditional entropy](#def-conditional-entropy).

:::
